title: CULypso: A Clustered Federated Unlearning paradigm for Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unlearning has emerged as an essential security and privacy-preserving solution in Machine Learning, enabling networks to support their clients' rights for data erasure, as mandated by data protection regulations. Introducing such a non-trivial task to an edge, highly mobile and time-sensitive vehicular network is an even greater, largely unexplored challenge. This article argues that a hierarchical Federated Unlearning approach could be aptly integrated into vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs), leveraging topology and movement to reduce communication, resource and time costs, while effectively forgetting a client's influence on the global model updates. In order to achieve this, we propose CULypso, an approximate, surgical, hierarchical unlearning algorithm tailored for clustered VANETs. translated_abstract: 遗忘学习已成为机器学习中一项至关重要的安全与隐私保护解决方案，使网络能够支持客户端依据数据保护法规所享有的数据删除权。而将这样一个并不简单的任务引入边缘的、高度移动且时间敏感的车辆网络，则是一个更为巨大且在很大程度上尚未被探索的挑战。本文论证了分层联邦遗忘方法可以恰当地集成到车辆自组织网络中，通过利用网络拓扑与车辆移动性来降低通信、资源和时间成本，同时有效地遗忘某一客户端对全局模型更新的影响。为实现这一目标，我们提出了CULypso，一种为集群式车辆自组织网络量身定制的近似式、精准式、分层式遗忘算法。该算法受希腊神话中的仙女卡吕普索（Calypso）启发，其名字意为“隐藏知识之人”，CULypso的大写字母即指代……
tldr: 本文提出CULypso，一种专为集群式车辆自组织网络设计的分层联邦遗忘算法，利用网络拓扑与车辆移动性降低通信、资源和时间开销，并能有效遗忘客户端对全局模型更新的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CULypso, an approximate, surgical, hierarchical federated unlearning algorithm tailored for clustered VANETs, which leverages network topology and vehicle mobility to reduce communication, resource and time costs while effectively erasing a client's influence on global model updates.
